snippet.title: [PS3] VIVIDRED OPERATION -Hyper Intimate Power-  ---- Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay for "VIVIDRED OPERATION -Hyper Intimate Power-" which is exclusive for PS3 in Japanese PSN as digital purchase only. The game is genuinely region lock so playing it on your US or EUR or any non JPN console will throw a error regarding region restriction, so check your console before buying.

The game is generally based on anime counterpart with minor story-retelling. You mission here is to smash the enemy to smithereens and at some episode you need to deal with that humongous boss.

Also the game deals with lots of lots of lots of fanservice and panty shots, so kids, this is not your game.

The playability of this game is quite hard, as you see in my gameplay, I struggle to hit the enemies speed wise and dexterity wise. Controls are badly done and you might have trouble opting on it. The game also had a VN (Visual Novel) like feeling on it which you are required to reply on a conversation depends on what you chosen and this might affect your overall grade in the episode (not generally affect the storyline overall)

In the end, if you are at the right age to play this thing (CERO C, generally means any age 15 above) and fan of the anime title and also you want that fanservice that badly, then this is your game, else if youre looking for a decent 3D type hack and slash game, I suggest that you to avoid this game.
